summary: The writer drives to work every day and finds the traffic problem boring
Their commute grew from 45 minutes last year to 1 hour and 30 minutes now
People who buy new cars to show status and people who keep old cars both make traffic worse
The writer says the government should offer new ways to travel, such as more buses, but asks why people like to travel by car
arguments: Traffic has increased a lot: the writer's commute went from 45 minutes to 1 hour and 30 minutes
People who buy new cars to show their social status and people who keep old cars both make traffic worse
The government should offer new ways to travel, for example more buses
arguments_main: Names the suggestion that the government should offer new ways to travel (more buses) as the most important argument (the longer commute as evidence is also acceptable)
Gives a reason from the text, e.g. it is the writer's only proposed solution
